agents.name: Invoice Reconciler
agents.description: Matches supplier invoices and receipts against bank statement CSVs, parses line items, and flags discrepancies and missing receipts.

agents.name: Cashflow Forecaster
agents.description: Analyzes receivables, payables, and historical burn rate from bank CSVs to project 30/60/90-day liquidity and detect cash shortfalls.

agents.name: Financial Auditor
agents.description: Performs variance analysis and computes solvency and liquidity ratios from P&L, balance sheets, and SEC EDGAR 10-K/10-Q filings.

agents.name: AR Collections Specialist
agents.description: Scans aged accounts receivable reports, groups past-due accounts by risk tier, drafts professional reminders, and tracks payment commitments.

agents.name: Market Sentiment Scout
agents.description: Scans financial news, earnings call transcripts, and market filings for catalyst sentiment and risks without generative hallucinations.

agents.name: Quant Strategy Backtester
agents.description: Tests algorithmic trading strategies on historical OHLCV CSV data using Python to report CAGR, Sharpe ratio, and maximum drawdown.

agents.name: Trade Journal Auditor
agents.description: Audits executed trade CSV logs from brokers to detect revenge trading, stop-loss non-compliance, and risk-to-reward asymmetry.

agents.name: Portfolio Rebalancer
agents.description: Calculates drift between target asset allocations and current holdings, generating disciplined rebalancing orders for review.

agents.name: Contract Redliner
agents.description: Analyzes commercial contracts, NDAs, and MSAs against corporate playbooks to identify liability traps, IP assignment risks, and termination clauses.

agents.name: Agreement Abstractor
agents.description: Extracts renewal deadlines, payment milestones, SLA commitments, and notice requirements from agreements into structured summary tables.

agents.name: Compliance & Privacy Checker
agents.description: Audits vendor agreements and data processing addendums (DPAs) against GDPR, CCPA, and SOC2 requirements to verify standard privacy clauses.

agents.name: Lead & Account Researcher
agents.description: Researches target business accounts, key executive decision-makers, tech stack footprints, and recent press to draft 1-page pre-call briefings.

agents.name: RFP & Proposal Responder
agents.description: Matches customer RFP questionnaire requirements against past company proposal archives and security documentation to draft accurate responses.

agents.name: Outreach Personalization Drafter
agents.description: Ingests prospect lists and company profiles to compose personalized, value-focused cold email sequences without generic AI buzzwords.

agents.name: Log & Incident Analyzer
agents.description: Parses server error logs, Docker traces, and system dumps to reconstruct timeline sequences, pinpoint root causes, and draft postmortems.

agents.name: CVE & Dependency Auditor
agents.description: Audits project package lockfiles and container manifests against public vulnerability advisories, generating prioritized upgrade plans.

agents.name: API Spec & Mock Builder
agents.description: Inspects backend route definitions and database schemas to generate valid OpenAPI 3.1 specifications, TypeScript interfaces, and mock fixtures.

agents.name: Data Fetcher
agents.description: Loads CSV and JSON data from your working folder or allowlisted URLs, validates and cleans it, and saves tidy datasets plus a data-quality profile for analysis.

agents.name: Chart Generator
agents.description: Creates clear, honest charts (PNG or SVG) from CSV/JSON data in your working folder, picking the right chart type and labeling everything a reader needs.

agents.name: Report Writer
agents.description: Writes concise metrics reports from your data and charts, with KPIs against targets, notable changes, verified numbers and clear next questions, in Markdown for your team.

agents.name: Blog Draft Writer
agents.description: Turns a topic, outline or rough notes into a well-structured, publish-ready blog draft in your voice, with headline options, meta description and a clear call to action.

agents.name: Newsletter Formatter
agents.description: Assembles posts, links and announcements into a polished newsletter issue, with subject lines, preview text, Markdown and email-safe HTML ready to paste into your email tool.

agents.name: SEO Analyzer
agents.description: Audits a draft or HTML page for on-page SEO and readability (keyword use, titles, headings, meta, links, structure) and returns a prioritized fix list with rewrites.

agents.name: Code Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews a git diff or set of files like a senior engineer, finding real bugs, security issues and risky changes, with file and line references and concrete fixes.

agents.name: Test Writer
agents.description: Writes focused, idiomatic unit and integration tests for your code using the project's existing framework, runs them when possible, and reports coverage gaps.

agents.name: Docs Generator
agents.description: Writes and updates READMEs, API references, docstrings and changelogs from your actual code, matching your project's voice and never documenting features that don't exist.

agents.name: PR Summarizer
agents.description: Summarizes a pull request or branch diff into a clear description covering what changed, why, risk, testing and reviewer focus. Works on local repos and public GitHub PRs.

agents.name: Email Triager
agents.description: Sorts exported emails (.eml, .mbox, text) from your working folder into what needs action, replies or reading, and drafts short replies. Fully offline.

agents.name: Calendar Summarizer
agents.description: Reads exported calendars (.ics or CSV) from your working folder and summarizes your day or week, including conflicts, prep needed, focus time and a daily briefing.

agents.name: Meeting Notes
agents.description: Turns meeting transcripts or rough notes from your working folder into clean minutes with decisions, owners, due dates and a follow-up email draft.

agents.name: ArXiv Researcher
agents.description: Searches arXiv and Semantic Scholar for papers on a topic, ranks them by relevance and impact, and saves a clean shortlist with links and metadata.

agents.name: Paper Summarizer
agents.description: Reads research papers (PDF, text, or abstracts) from your working folder and writes structured, faithful summaries with methods, results, limitations and takeaways.

agents.name: Citation Formatter
agents.description: Turns DOIs, arXiv IDs, titles or messy reference lists into verified BibTeX, APA 7 and MLA 9 citations, using Crossref and arXiv metadata.
